name: RANT pair-reserve burn and sync
summary: A transfer of RANT to the token contract invoked _sellBurnLiquidityPairTokens(amount), which removed an attacker-sized amount of RANT directly from the RANT/WBNB pair and called sync() without removing WBNB. The resulting reserve collapse let rant_center sell the attacker's remaining RANT into the manipulated pair and extract its WBNB reserve.
notes: changeRant_node() set the node dependency used by _sellBurnLiquidityPairTokens. rant_center had been configured one block earlier, so this latest change completed the operational self-transfer, pair-burn, sync, and sell path.

The exploit transaction's WBNB transfer logs show 2,813.769505544453342436 WBNB entering the RANT/WBNB pair and 3,125.628310019077706276 WBNB leaving it across the manipulated swaps. The pair's exact transaction-local depletion was therefore 311.858804474624363840 WBNB. This gross loss exceeds the attacker's final BNB because the attacker separately paid the flash fee and a validator transfer. DefiLlama observed BNB at $655.15 at timestamp 1751728497, 99 seconds before the exploit.
